description: Finds real companies likely to buy your product. Searches the web for companies showing they have the problem you solve right now (hiring, launches, funding, expansion) and links the page behind every piece of evidence. Uses the product saved on your account. Takes up to a couple of minutes; nothing is charged if no company has sourced evidence.

companyName.description: Your company name. Defaults to the product saved on your account.

coreCapability.description: The single most important thing your product does — the core capability that makes customers buy

productDescription.description: What your product does and who it's for. Defaults to the product saved on your account.

targetMarket.description: Target market segment (e.g., "Series A SaaS companies")
